claims: The American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) is based in Washington, D.C.
AIPAC is backed by a reported 5-6 million members.
AIPAC has a grassroots network of over 5 million members nationwide.
AIPAC is funded by American citizens and supporters.
AIPAC has an associated super PAC.
AIPAC focuses on passing legislation that strengthens the U.S.-Israel alliance.
AIPAC focuses on providing security assistance to Israel.
AIPAC focuses on supporting policies aimed at combating threats like Iran.
In 2024, 96% of AIPAC-backed candidates won their general election races.
Critics, particularly within the progressive wing of the Democratic Party, argue that AIPAC works to "silence" criticism of Israel.
Critics argue AIPAC's intervention in primaries splits the party.
Some activists demand AIPAC register as a foreign agent.
The American Indian Parent Advisory Committee (AIPAC) is a separate organization.
